verdict.rationale: Bevy's own docs list Web as a supported platform, and its official examples are compiled to WASM and run in the browser using WebGL, so the 'runs in the browser on WebGL today' core is documented first-party. Nothing in the pack covers payload size or a WebGPU path, which is roughly half the story. missing for 10: any evidence on WASM payload/bundle size, any documented WebGPU support or roadmap, independent hands-on corroboration of web deployment.

support.subject: As a web developer, my game runs in the browser with a reasonable payload — WebGL today, and a credible WebGPU story
